structure: Part 4, Dashboard, sign-in and cross-service sessions. Read in full: 8 specs and 11 support files. Animals specs: tests/animals/e2e/pages/notification-dashboard.spec.ts (8 tests: start a journey and list the draft; 4 'dashboard basics' tests for landing, starting a notification, list and result count, card details; 3 'notification card actions by status' tests for draft actions, submitted actions and copy-as-new), tests/animals/e2e/pages/notification-dashboard-pagination.spec.ts (1 test: GOV.UK pagination and result range), tests/animals/e2e/features/notification-dashboard-sort.spec.ts (3 test definitions: default option, the four options, and a loop that generates one 'submits and reloads' test per option, so 6 tests at run time), tests/animals/e2e/features/notification-dashboard-search.spec.ts (7 tests: search form, whole-reference match, View after search, no match, free text, sort keeps the search, page param keeps the search), tests/animals/e2e/features/auth.spec.ts (10 tests: 8 sign-in/sign-out tests and 2 'unauthenticated entry' tests for a deep journey page). INS specs: tests/ins/e2e/features/notification-dashboard-navigation.spec.ts (1 test: INS dashboard View opens the animals notification view), tests/ins/e2e/features/aggregated-notification.spec.ts (1 compose-only test of the INS backend's aggregated notification document through draft and submit), tests/ins/e2e/features/cross-service-sessions.spec.ts (1 compose-only test: animals, INS and plants sessions held together in one browser). Support code: page-objects/animals/dashboard-page.ts (heading, start button, sort, search form, results label, summary cards and their fields, pagination, card actions), page-objects/ins/dashboard-page.ts and index.ts (INS dashboard heading, search, row, View link, no-results), page-objects/shared/auth sign-in, organisation picker and sign-out pages, fixtures/auth-state.ts (per-service session cookies, per-target landing pages, cold start), domain/animals/constants/sort-by-values.ts, domain/ins/models/db/aggregated-notification-document.ts, flows/animals/seeded-journey.ts (seeding through the frontend's own form routes, the create, amend, cancel-amend and delete routes) and adapters/http/notification-api-client.ts (backend notification API routes). Claims run spec by spec, then the support code's facts the specs do not assert, then gaps: the organisation picker has a page object but no spec in this slice, sort order and the empty dashboard are not proven end to end, and the INS dashboard's no-results state and columns are not asserted.
